achievements.label: Shatter the Winter Night
achievements.descriptionLocked: Some say winter cannot be conquered, but we have done it.
achievements.descriptionUnlocked: Some say winter cannot be conquered, but we have done it.
achievements.unlockMessage: Some say winter cannot be conquered, but we have done it. [Successfully repel the Seventeenth Night once.]

achievements.label: Defying the Blizzard
achievements.descriptionLocked: The wind and snow have no right to take the laurels from warriors; we will crown ourselves.
achievements.descriptionUnlocked: The wind and snow have no right to take the laurels from warriors; we will crown ourselves.
achievements.unlockMessage: The wind and snow have no right to take the laurels from warriors; we will crown ourselves. [Achieve the 'Hero of the Soviet Union' or 'Soldier Forever' ending with the Revenant Army entering Stalingrad.]

achievements.label: Unremembered
achievements.descriptionLocked: The cold wind will not remember the name of a snowflake, nor will the earth.
achievements.descriptionUnlocked: The cold wind will not remember the name of a snowflake, nor will the earth.
achievements.unlockMessage: The cold wind will not remember the name of a snowflake, nor will the earth. [Die in battle against the 'Seventeenth Night'.]

achievements.label: "Face Your Sins"
achievements.descriptionLocked: Those who commit evil often cannot face their sins, nor the fruits of their sins.
achievements.descriptionUnlocked: Those who commit evil often cannot face their sins, nor the fruits of their sins.
achievements.unlockMessage: Those who commit evil often cannot face their sins, nor the fruits of their sins. [Make the 'Iron-Eater' meet the 'Seventeenth Night'.]

achievements.label: Winter Rebirth
achievements.descriptionLocked: Beneath the cold wind, hope breaks through the ground.
achievements.descriptionUnlocked: Beneath the cold wind, hope breaks through the ground.
achievements.unlockMessage: Beneath the cold wind, hope breaks through the ground. [Make the 'War-Maker' meet the 'Seventeenth Night'.]
